ja: 店頭販売 ＭＳ本体（別売り）にジョイントして、Ｖ２アサルトバスターガンダム Ver．Kaを再現可能な拡張パーツが登場！
※ 当商品にＭＳ本体は付属しません。
●　Ｖ２アサルトバスターガンダム Ver.Kaを再現するための、武装パーツ一式を同梱。
追加武装はパーツ着脱式で再現。Ｖ２アサルトガンダム、Ｖ２バスターガンダムも組み換え式で再現可能
●　ＭＳ本体用アップデートパーツが付属
重量ある装備を保持するため、新構造の内部フレームと一部外装のアップデートパーツが付属する。
●　店頭販売ＭＳ本体に準拠した成形色で再現。
ゴールド部はゴールド成形色を採用。
●　Ｖ２アサルトバスターガンダムを再現する、 新規デザインの“Ver．Ka”マーキング＜水転写式＞付属。
〈セット内容〉
アサルトパーツ一式 ／ バスターパーツ一式 ／ 本体用アップデートパーツ ／ “Ver．Ka”水転写式デカール
１／１００スケール組み立て式プラモデル

en: Over-the-counter sales: Joint with MS body (sold separately) to create V2 Assault Buster Gundam Ver. Expansion parts that can reproduce Ka are now available!
*The MS body is not included with this product.
● Includes a set of armed parts to reproduce the V2 Assault Buster Gundam Ver.Ka.
Additional weapons are reproduced with detachable parts. V2 Assault Gundam and V2 Buster Gundam can also be reproduced by recombination.
● Comes with update parts for MS body
In order to hold heavy equipment, a newly constructed internal frame and some updated exterior parts are included.
● Reproduced in molding color that conforms to the MS body sold in stores.
The gold part uses gold molding color.
● Includes newly designed “Ver.Ka” marking (water transfer type) that reproduces the V2 Assault Buster Gundam.
<Set contents>
Assault parts set / Buster parts set / Update parts for main body / “Ver.Ka” water transfer decal
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/ABS
・No adhesive is used in the assembly.
This product is expanded to "MG 1/100 V2 Gundam Ver. Ka" (sold separately) which is currently being released at stores nationwide.
A complete set of parts to reproduce "V2 Assault Buster Gundam".
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the posted photo, you will need this product and the pre-assembly "MG 1/100 V2 Gundam Ver. Ka" (sold separately).
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. It is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
